description: HTML/CSS to Image is a service that converts HTML, CSS, templates, and public URLs into rendered images and PDFs. It is used for generated social cards, screenshots, certificates, reports, and similar visual assets.
summary: htmlcsstoimage.com exposes two developer integration surfaces: an authenticated REST API at `https://hcti.io` using Basic auth with API ID/API Key, and an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp.hcti.io` with Dynamic Client Registration for self-onboarding clients.
